audit.why: Lane story coherent: skill levels 1-3, Cassiopeia dominant 4-5 through first item (Q move speed, Miasma grounding, Twin Fang ramp), Viktor at two items. TRICKY 7/10 despite 55.63% WR — packet flags the tension; kit supports the phase story, so left as-is and noted.

Spikes correct: her 3-5 takeover, her 6 (Petrifying Gaze + Miasma), her first item, Viktor two items. Real names throughout — Noxious Blast, Miasma, Twin Fang, Petrifying Gaze. Packet suspectName 'Land Petrifying Gaze' is a false positive: Petrifying Gaze is her real R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field has no digit; Miasma is 24s rank 1 / 16s max, her R 120s, Viktor W 17s and R 120s. Twin Fang heals — anti-heal interaction already on the page (report[8]).
audit.why: Cooldowns are in the kit files; Miasma grounding vs Viktor is positional (Viktor has no dash) but it denies Flash-walking her follow-up as prose says.
